title: Add JourneyMap stepwise RAG tutorial + interactive playground
author: Maya Chen
description:
Introduces a new developer-facing tutorial and interactive playground called 'JourneyMap' that demonstrates stepwise Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) flows with tool-calling, staged retrieval strategies, and live telemetry hooks. Motivation: current quickstarts cover building basic RAG pipelines and tool calling but lack a compact, visual stepwise tutorial that demonstrates how retrieval strategy, prompt shaping, and tool fallbacks interact at each turn. JourneyMap is intended for developers and platform engineers to iterate quickly on prompt sets and retrieval policies while observing token-level cost and latency trade-offs.

What this PR adds:
- docs/journeymap/guide.md: step-by-step tutorial (authoring, index strategies, retrieval policy matrix, tool-binding examples)
- examples/journeymap/playground/: a lightweight static playground (React) that runs against local dev server or hosted Redwood demo and visualizes a conversation timeline with retrieval snapshots, tool call events, and telemetry traces
- examples/journeymap/templates/: templated prompt sets, test queries, and an eval harness used to surface regressions when rollout changes retrieval params
- docs/journeymap/telemetry.md: best-practices for instrumenting JourneyMap with Redwood Console probes and custom tracing for stepwise assertion checks

Compatibility notes: the playground uses the Redwood hosted v1 SDK surface but falls back to compatible OpenAI-ish request shapes when feature flags are disabled. No runtime code changes to core inference runtime are required. The tutorial references the new 'staged_retrieval' policy name introduced in ENG-2189.

How to try locally (short):
1) yarn && yarn workspace journeymap start:dev (starts a small static server + proxy)
2) export REDWOOD_API_KEY=... or run with --local-index to use the included local inverted index
3) Open http://localhost:3005 to step through the JourneyMap scenarios and toggle retrieval policies and tool fallbacks

Checklist:
- [x] authoring guide and walkthroughs
- [x] minimal interactive playground with telemetry traces and replayable sessions
- [x] test templates and smoke CI to exercise main scenarios
- [x] accessibility and keyboard navigation for timeline widget (basic)

Notes for reviewers: please focus on the conceptual guidance in guide.md (is the staged retrieval section clear), the safety wording in telemetry.md, and the example prompt templates for potential hallucination vectors. This is a docs-first PR; the playground is intentionally minimal and intended as an onboarding artifact rather than a production component.
